author: Avetetsuya Studios
title: Hiring freelance artists for character, background, and game art
content:
HIRING
LOOKING FOR FREELANCE ARTISTS

Avetetsuya Studios saat ini membuka kesempatan bagi freelance artist untuk berkolaborasi dalam berbagai proyek mendatang.

Kami mencari artist yang memiliki kemampuan dalam:
-Character Design & Illustration
-Character Sprites
-Background & Environment Art
-Webtoon / Comic Artwork
-Game & Digital Art Assets
-Ilustrasi dan visual development lainnya

Kualifikasi:
-Memiliki portofolio yang kuat dan dasar menggambar yang baik
-Mampu mengikuti art direction yang telah ditentukan atau beradaptasi dengan berbagai gaya visual
-Memahami anatomi, komposisi, dan penggunaan warna dengan baik
-Mampu menyelesaikan pekerjaan sesuai dengan deadline proyek
Terbiasa menerima feedback dan melakukan revisi
-Memiliki komunikasi profesional dan etos kerja yang dapat diandalkan

Cara Melamar:
Bagi Anda yang tertarik untuk bergabung sebagai freelance artist, silakan kirimkan portofolio dan perkenalan singkat ke:
avetetsuyastudios@gmail.com

Gunakan subject email:
Freelance Artist Application – [Nama Anda]

Dalam email, Anda juga dapat mencantumkan:
Jenis artwork yang Anda kuasai atau minati
Art style yang biasa Anda gunakan
Ketersediaan untuk mengerjakan proyek
Rate freelance

Artist yang terpilih akan dihubungi untuk kesempatan berkolaborasi pada proyek-proyek freelance mendatang bersama Avetetsuya Studios.

author: Alexander Newby
title: Let's Roll Press is looking for Artists
content:
**Let's Roll Press is looking for Artists**

About Let's Roll Press
We're the people behind Chapelwick, the cosmic horror campaign that launched on Kickstarter last year.
We're expanding our art team to accelerate development.
I've attached some images from our project so you can get an idea of what we're looking for.

The Role
We're looking for a few talented artists to create professional illustrations for our Campaign Setting.
New illustration batches are commissioned as each batch is completed.

What We're Looking For
* Strong portfolio demonstrating TTRPG or fantasy illustration experience
* Ability to work from detailed creative briefs, maintain visual consistency across series, and accommodate art direction and revisions
* Proficiency with digital art tools
* Fast turnaround without sacrificing quality
* Professional communication and reliable delivery
* Bonus: Experience with both 2D and 3D workflows
* Bonus: Familiarity with Elden Ring, Bloodborne, Dark Souls, etc.

Expectations
* Professional design and execution of character, environment, and/or encounter illustrations
* Ability to interpret detailed briefs and ask questions before starting to reduce delivery lag and revision cycles
* Reliable monthly deadlines

Terms
* Independent contractor basis (1099)
* $275–$650+ per illustration
* Commissions paid via PayPal only
* Ongoing collaboration opportunities as we continue to grow. If we like working together, we'll include you in future projects!

To apply tap the link below:
https://forms.cloud.microsoft/r/3jtz31vMRz
